project.name: Vidocq :: Core Extensions :: Mansart Transactions :: Codegen Bundle
project.description:
Companion codegen bundle for vidocq-runtime-mansart-transactions-extension. Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the application depends on the Mansart Transactions extension.
Pulls in mansart-transactions-cdi, which hosts the BuildCompatibleExtension registering @TransactionScoped + declaring @Enhancement(TransactionScoped) so that Vauban's APT index includes user beans annotated @TransactionScoped. Without this entry, every @TransactionScoped user bean would be invisible.
